title: Why the main method is public and static
answer: The main method is `public` because the Java launcher must be able to access it from outside the application class when starting the program. It is `static` because the launcher needs to invoke the entry point before any application object has been created; a static method can be called at the class level without constructing an instance. These two modifiers solve different startup requirements: `public` provides accessibility, while `static` removes the need for an object. The standard standalone Java entry point is therefore `public static void main(String[] args)`. Removing `public` prevents normal external access to the expected entry point, while removing `static` leaves only an instance method that the normal launcher cannot use as the standard starting method.

steps.title: Explain public accessibility
steps.question: The Java launcher is infrastructure outside the ordinary application instance, so the entry method cannot depend on private access that only code inside the class can use. Why does declaring `main` as public satisfy the visibility side of the launch contract?
steps.why: Public allows the launcher to access the method from outside the class boundary.

data.documentation: Public members are accessible from outside the declaring class subject to normal Java access rules.

steps.title: Explain static startup
steps.question: At the moment a standalone Java program begins, there is no requirement that an instance of the application class already exists, and constructing one could itself require application logic. Why does `static` let startup proceed without creating `MainMethodLab` first?
steps.why: Static binds the method to the class rather than to a specific object instance.
steps.why_te: Popup open ayindani matrame point kaadu; current caret/symbol context batti IDE enduku ee information leda action ni suggest chestundo observe chesi eppudu use cheyyalo ardham cheskondi. `static` method class ki belong avutundi, specific object instance ki kaadu. Kabatti launcher `new MainMethodLab()` create cheyyakunda direct ga entry point ni invoke cheyyagaladu.

data.documentation: A static method belongs to the class and can be invoked without an instance.
